prompt:

Below the title: 13 vertical color swatch bars in a single horizontal row, evenly spaced, each a tall vertical rectangle of flat solid color, crisp clean edges, no gradient or texture inside. Each swatch must render the exact HEX with full fidelity: flat solid, no shading, no gradient, no texture. Labels perfectly readable.

Hard constraints: all 13 swatches exact HEX-accurate flat solid colors; strictly 16:9; white/off-white pure background; no illustrations, no photos, no sample scenes; clean sans-serif labels fully readable; single horizontal row with even spacing; no watermark; no logo; title is largest text; professional production-grade Adobe Color / Pantone x film color script look.

name: staging_SEG-1F_门口撞破
display_name: SEG-1F 门口撞破俯视调度图
design: top-down staging diagram for three-person doorway reveal in cold morning penthouse hallway
prompt:
A hand-drawn top-down bird's eye view blocking diagram on aged off-white production paper, in the style of a professional film staging diagram. Image aspect ratio strictly 16:9 horizontal landscape.

Layout: top-down schematic floor plan of a luxury penthouse bedroom doorway and short hallway in confident graphite pencil with selective red colored pencil annotations. Hand-lettered labels in readable slightly uneven serif block letters.

Title at top center: "CUO AI EP1 - SEG-1F - STAGING DIAGRAM". Subtitle: "BEDROOM DOORWAY MORNING REVEAL / 3 ADULT MEN + DOOR FRAME / JASPER OPENS, ETHAN ADVANCES, OLIVER TRAPPED".

Environmental anchors: a concealed bedroom door at frame-right, polished metal handle, short hallway leading from living room at frame-left, sofa edge and black marble threshold suggested at far left, pale bedding glimpsed inside bedroom as a labelled outline, floor-to-ceiling window light direction arrow from top.

Character positions as top-down figure-outline silhouettes with labels: OLIVER near the bedroom threshold, turned toward the door, clutching clothes close to his chest, shoulders closed; ETHAN behind him from the living-room side, calm adult male silhouette, one arm angled as if just released or about to gesture, not touching intimately; JASPER outside/at the door line, pushing the door inward, body frozen in shock. Show adult body scale differences: Ethan broad and mature, Jasper tall slim, Oliver lean smaller. No explicit nudity; all silhouettes are schematic.

Camera positions + path: red camera triangles S1/S2/S3/S4 all on the hallway/living-room side of the action axis. S1 low tracking from living room toward door, 35mm. S2 over Oliver's shoulder toward the handle, 50mm. S3 doorway reveal wide two-plane shot, 35mm. S4 hard-cut reaction angle on Jasper and Ethan, 85mm. Red curved arrow marks Oliver flee path to the door. Red dashed sight-lines: Oliver to door handle, Jasper to Ethan, Ethan to Jasper, Jasper to Oliver. Red 180-degree axis line runs along the doorway threshold from living room to bedroom; label "CAMERAS STAY HALL SIDE / 180 AXIS".

Final frame note: red dashed rectangle at the doorway labelled "FINAL FRAME: JASPER IN DOOR / OLIVER FOREGROUND / ETHAN BACKGROUND, OFF-AXIS". Lower-left legend: "red triangles=cameras / dashed red=sight-lines / red curve=flee path / red line=180 axis".

Hard constraints: top-down bird's eye view only; aged off-white paper, graphite pencil base, black ink labels, red pencil only for cameras, paths, sight-lines, axis and final-frame rectangle; strictly 16:9; no digital painting, no 3D, no photoreal elements, no colored scene art except red pencil; readable labels; non-explicit schematic adult blocking.
